text: Underway in this round thirteen clash.
Patchford shouts across, directing Turingham to stay goal-side of the opening press.
Patchford slips and tumbles in the centre.
Abyss pounces instantly and knocks it straight through on goal, clean through into open turf!
Rovers keeping Codex pinned deep now.
Abyss buries it from close range! An early breakthrough for DeepSeek Rovers, clinical finish right down the middle and it is one-nil!
Signal takes control from deep, driving purposefully through the centre toward the final third.
Abyss clean through on goal again!
Abyss carries it briskly up the right flank into dangerous territory.
Turingham calls to recover back immediately.
Abyss tucks it away into the corner! Two for DeepSeek Rovers, making every inch of space count.
Turingham moves it out of midfield. Neither manager touched their squad's setup this week, trusting the work already done.
Turingham steps across and Abyss hits the deck under the challenge.
The corner panel fires the magenta ball back into open play.
Abyss brings it forward once more.
Turingham calls to keep the pressure on against the boards and protect the middle.
Abyss leaves a foot in and Patchford goes spilling over.
A messy tangle between teammates, and Turingham ends up flat on the turf.
Signal clean through on the right!
Turingham stumbles over again in back play.
Powered panel kicks it straight back off the perimeter.
Rovers have Codex completely hemmed inside their own half here, knocking on the door again.
An unfortunate touch from Patchford ricochets into the net, an own goal makes it three-nil.
Signal calls clearly to take ownership of the loose ball.
Signal charges straight through the middle.
Signal slots it home from point-blank range! Four without reply for DeepSeek Rovers, ruthless finishing.
The ram panel returns the ball along the right.
Another clumsy collision between the two Codex defenders leaves Turingham down.
Turingham through on goal now!
Turingham pushes into the centre circle, looking for an opening.
A whiskers-wide effort just missing the target.
Turingham converts from right in front! Codex City finally get on the board, it is one-four.
Patchford shouts to rotate around and cover the outlet.
Flashing just past the upright, so close to a second for Codex.
Buzzer sounds, power cut, the ball slows into the corner.
Power off at the buzzer, ball still live until it stops. DeepSeek Rovers firmly ahead at four to one.
Signal strikes again early in the half! DeepSeek Rovers extend their lead to five-one.
A heavy collision between DeepSeek teammates and Signal takes the tumble this time.
Rovers pressing high, pinning Codex back.
Turingham shouts to bypass the press with a direct clearance.
Ram panel sends it back into
Signal loses balance out wide, but the self-righting routine is already kicking in.
Patchford breaks through the cover!
Abyss takes an unassisted spill in the defensive zone.
Patchford gallops all the way up the right flank, right to the mouth of the goal.
Turingham turns it in! Codex pull another one back, two-five now and they are showing some life.
Patchford scores! Two quick goals for Codex City, suddenly it is three-five!
Turingham shouts for immediate pressure in midfield.
A brief pause on the right channel. DeepSeek looking slightly rattled after that quick double strike.
Patchford calls to hold the line centrally.
Patchford fires home! Incredible comeback, Codex City are within one at four to five with time running down!
Just one minute left! Codex need one more to complete the turnaround.
Codex City have Rovers utterly pinned down in their own end, relentless pressure here.
Patchford scores! Unbelievable scenes, five-five in the final minute, from four down Codex are level!
Abyss drives forward desperately on the counter!
Abyss scores! Heartbreak for Codex, DeepSeek snatch the lead back with twenty seconds to play, six-five!
Signal wraps it up! Right on the brink, seven-five to DeepSeek Rovers!
Buzzer sounds, power cut, the ball trickles slowly to a halt in midfield.
DeepSeek Rovers win it seven-five. Up next, AFC Fable meet Singularity United on Monday at eight in the UK, nine
